D41·nq26 — 2026-09-24
rule: Dirty-only regeneration must stay byte-identical to a full regeneration: the event-by-event parity test over real logs and team100 gates every change, and a renderer that reads anything beyond slug and its SessionState must widen the fingerprint first.
chose: Regenerate projections dirty-only for rust-core 4.4 (sofar-3c's proposal, approved by sofar-e8 within the operator's 01M39ED9 scope, 2026-09-24). plan.md, decisions.md and memory.md render every time, as today. A session file re-renders only when its input fingerprint sha256({slug, SessionState}), its on-disk size and mtime, or the manifest key (engine version + schema hash + a build-time fingerprint of the implementation's template sources) changed. The manifest is derived only (.sofar/.index/projections/<slug>.<impl>.json, atomic), and a missing or corrupt one means everything is dirty. Templates are untouched; only the scheduling changes.
over: Re-rendering all session files on every append (76% of post-tool at team100, reading back 8,576 files); caching rendered output without an on-disk check (a hand edit or checkout would go unnoticed)
because: renderSession reads only the slug plus one finalized SessionState, so an unchanged input means unchanged output. The template fingerprint catches any template edit within a version. An event-by-event parity test against full regeneration proves the result byte-identical. Expected post-tool at team100: ~251 → ~100 ms, relative.
